youtube_title: Market Open on a SUNDAY? Muhurat Trading Explained 🪔 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Guess: why is the stock market open on a Sunday this Diwali?

Muhurat trading is a special 1-hour session on Diwali: the new Samvat year begins and people buy a little for shagun. This year: Sunday 8 Nov, 2:20 to 3:30 PM (usually evening, this year afternoon). But the market doesn't know the day is shubh. In one hour, prices can go up or down.

Rule: if you join, make a small token buy, only something already in your plan. No F&O, no tips.
Moral: Muhurat is a tradition, not a profit guarantee.

Source: NSE circular, Muhurat trading 8 Nov 2026
Education only, not investment advice.
